ch43.note: The candid statement of purpose Chen placed at the head of the whole work, in which he set out his aims and disclaimers—among them his insistence that this is a truthful record, not an autobiography. He refers back to it here as the frame for his closing thoughts.

It was a settled courtesy of the Chinese literary world to ask a friend skilled in calligraphy to brush the cover title and title-page inscription of one's book, both as a mark of esteem and as a token of the friendship—so having Luo Jing 'write the covers' of these volumes was an honor freely given and gratefully received.
